messages.content: 獲取美國波士頓的溫度和濕度預報，以及意大利羅馬的降水預報，為未來10天。

function.name: weather_forecast_precipitation
function.description: Retrieve a precipitation forecast for a specific location for a certain number of days. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city that you want to get the precipitation forecast for.

days.description: Number of days for the forecast.
